blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

blocks.en:
Looped Transformers reuse a shared block of layers multiple times in a single forward pass, achieving deeper computation without adding parameters ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ) .
Depth scales with the number of loops rather than the number of layers, making loops a simple lever for both stronger performance and test-time compute scaling.
Yet turning this promise into significant and consistent gains for LLMs remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh:
循环变换器在一次前行通道中多次再利用一个共享的地层块,实现更深的计算而无需添加参数(Dehghani等,2019;Giannou等,2023.).
以环数而非地层数为深度尺度,使环能成为更强性能和测试时间计算尺度的简单杠杆.
然而,将这一承诺转化为对地方政府信贷机制的重大和持续收益仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en:
One line of work pretrains looped LLMs from scratch ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
However, the gains remain modest or even negative at comparable cost ( Zeitoun et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Given the expense of pretraining, this direction offers limited returns.
blocks.zh:
一行工作前环绕LLMs从零开始(Geiping等,2025;Zhu等,2025)。
然而,收益仍然微乎其微,甚至以可比成本为负(Zeitoun等,2026;Wang等,2026)。
考虑到预先培训的费用,这一方向提供的回报有限。

blocks.en:
A more promising approach finetunes pretrained LLMs into loops ( Marchenko et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ) , reusing their learned capabilities at a fraction of the pretraining cost.
As illustrated in Figure 1 a,b, although these designs vary in their looping pattern ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; You et al., 2026 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zeitoun et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Marques et al., 2026 ) , they all compress the outputs of earlier loops into a narrow pathway.
This limits what later loops can build on, yielding only marginal gains and leaving the potential of loops largely unrealized.
blocks.zh:
一个更有希望的方法将预先训练的LLMs微调为循环(Marchenko等,2026;You等,2026),以预训练成本的一小部分重用所学能力.
如图1a,b所示,虽然这些设计在环绕模式上有所不同(Zhu等人,2025年;You等人,2026年;Geiping等人,2025年;Zeitoun等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Zhuang等人,2026年;Marques等人,2026年),但它们都把早先环绕的输出压缩为一条狭窄的路径.
这限制了以后的循环可以扩大的方面,只产生边际收益,而使循环的潜力基本上未实现。

blocks.en:
A natural remedy is to let each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops.
Attention Residuals (AttnRes) ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) offer exactly this: each layer builds its input by attending to all earlier layer outputs.
However, AttnRes is designed for standard Transformers, where the sources differ in content and are fixed in number.
Our key insight is that loops break both assumptions: the sources are iterates of the same layers, so they become similar in content and grow in number.
blocks.zh:
一个自然的补救措施是让每个被环绕的层直接关注更早环绕的输出.
注意残留物(AttnRes)(基米) Team等人,2026年)给出的正是这一点:每层通过关注所有更早的地层产出来建立其投入.
然而,AttnRes是针对标准变形器设计的,其中出处在内容上不同,数量上固定.
我们的关键见解是循环打破了两种假设:来源是同层的迭代,因此在内容上变得相近并增加数量.

blocks.en:
This causes three problems.
(i) Similar iterates. The outputs are iterates of the same layers and grow harder to tell apart as loops deepen.
(ii) Early convergence. The AttnRes weights converge early in finetuning, and because the keys come from similar outputs, the model cannot learn to tell sources apart before the pattern is set.
(iii) Growing sources. Each loop adds new sources to the full attention window, so layers can shortcut to earlier loops, skipping intermediate ones.
blocks.zh:
这造成了三个问题。
(一) 类似迭代。 产出是同一层的迭代,随着循环的加深,更难分辨。
(二) 早期趋同。 AttnRes权重早期在微调中会汇合,而由于密钥来自相近的输出,模型无法在模式设定前学会分辨出出出出处.
(三) 不断增长的来源。 每个回路会给全关注窗口添加出新的源,因此分层可以快捷到更早的回路,跳过中间回路.

blocks.en:
Based on these observations, we propose Loop Residuals (LoopRes), an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs.
LoopRes builds on AttnRes and introduces two improvements.
(i) It assigns each source a trainable, loop-aware key alongside its content key, encoding the structural relationship of loops and layers.
Because these keys are directly optimized, the model can learn to differentiate sources before the weights converge.
(ii) It restricts each layer to a residual window of the latest W W loops.
This eliminates shortcuts to earlier loops, forces every loop to build incrementally on recent ones, and keeps the overhead constant as loops deepen.
blocks.zh:
基于这些观察,我们提议循环残余物(LoopRes),这是一种有效、可扩展和简单的方法,将循环转化为预先培训的有限责任公司的重大和持续收益。
LoopRes基于AttnRes,并引入了两个改进.
(一) 它将每个源指定一个可被训练的,有回路意识的密钥与其内容密钥相并列,编码出循环和分层的结构关系.
因为这些键被直接优化,该模型可以学习在权重汇合之前区分出出出源.
(二) 它将每层限制在最新的W W回路的剩余窗口上.
这消除了去往更早的环路的捷径,迫使每个环路在最近环路上逐渐地建立起来,并随着环路的加深而保持了俯冲常数.

blocks.en:
Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 math and code benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains.
On Qwen3-1.7B-Base at 2 × \times compute, it improves the average score by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the SOTA baseline, and its gain continues to grow as loops deepen.
The gains are consistent: LoopRes improves by 10.0% to 37.7% on the larger Qwen3-{4B,8B,30B-A3B}-Base, as well as on Qwen3.5 and Llama-3.2 from different families.
Notably, LoopRes on the 4B backbone even surpasses SFT on the 8B one, showing that loops can bridge the gap to larger models.
blocks.zh:
来自3个模范家庭和9个数学和代码基准的6个经过预先培训的法学硕士课程,LoopRes取得了显著和一致的成果。
在Qwen3-1.7B-Base以2×\times计算时,它比SFT提高了29.1%的平均得分,比SOTA基线的得分翻了一番多,随着循环的加深,它的得分继续增长.
收益一致:在较大的Qune3-{4B,8B,30B-A3B}-Base以及不同家庭的Qune3.5和Llama-3.2上,LoopRes改进了10.0%至37.7%。
值得注意的是,4B主干线上的LoopRes甚至超过了8B一线的SFT,表明回路可以将差距拉入更大的模型.

blocks.en:
More importantly, LoopRes achieves better scaling at test time: from 1.7B to 8B, its score rises with a steeper slope than SFT as compute grows.
It thus reaches a higher ceiling, significantly exceeding the best score of SFT.
At the same time, it is more efficient on long outputs, reaching the same score at a lower compute cost.
Together, these results establish loop depth as an axis of test-time scaling, benefiting both inference and post-training rollouts.
We hope LoopRes serves as a simple and effective foundation for scaling LLMs along this axis.
blocks.zh:
更重要的是,LoopRes在测试时间实现更好的缩放:从1.7B到8B,它的分数随着计算增长而以比SFT更陡峭的坡度上升.
因此达到更高的上限,大大超过SFT的最佳得分.
同时,它对于长产出效率更高,以较低的计算成本达到相同的分数.
这些结果共同确立了循环深度,作为试验时间缩放的轴线,既有利于推论,也有利于培训后推广。
我们希望LoopRes成为沿这一轴线扩大有限责任公司规模的简单而有效的基础。

The coda runs once on the output of loop L L to predict the next token, and the model is finetuned with the cross-entropy loss on this prediction.

blocks.en: 2.3 Challenges of Looping with Attention Residuals
blocks.zh: 2.3 注意循环方面的挑战

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 2 a, the iterates of the same block are far more similar to each other than to other blocks.
Because the content keys are derived from these sources, similar iterates receive similar scores.
With three loops, the output query in Figure 2 b clearly separates the two blocks, but the iterates within each block are hard to tell apart.
With seven loops in Figure 2 d, this worsens, as many iterates collapse onto nearly the same score.
blocks.zh:
如图2a所示,同一区块的相距远比其他区块相似。
由于内容密钥来源于这些来源,相类似的迭代获得相近分数.
通过三个回路,图2b中的输出查询可以明确区分出两个区块,但每个区块内的展出很难区分出.
随着图2d中的7个循环,这种情况恶化了,因为许多迭代倒向几乎相同的分数.

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 2 c, the query norm reaches most of its final value within the first third of finetuning and then levels off.
We hypothesize that this commits the model to its early connection pattern, since content keys change only indirectly, through the hidden states.
blocks.zh:
如图2c所示,查询规范在微调的前三分之一内达到其最终值的大部分,然后进行平分.
我们假设这让模型与早期的连接模式相一致,因为内容密钥只是间接地通过隐藏状态而变化.

blocks.en:
The source set grows with every loop, and AttnRes attends to all of them, so layers can skip intermediate loops.
As shown in Figure 2 e, the weight on the path through every loop falls from 33.7% with three loops to 0.05% with seven loops, and the most likely paths never reach the later loops, suggesting that deeper loops add little effective depth.
blocks.zh:
源集随每个回路而增长,AttnRes关注所有回路,因此分层可以跳过中间回路.
如图2 e所示,通过每个回路的路径重量从33.7%有3个回路下降到0.05%有7个回路,最有可能回路的回路从未到达后回回路,说明更深回路增加的有效深度很少.

blocks.en: 2.4 LoopRes
blocks.zh: 2.4 循环

blocks.en:
Building on the analysis above, we propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs.
As illustrated in Figure 1 d, LoopRes keeps the input-dependent mechanism of AttnRes and introduces two improvements: (i) It assigns each source a loop-aware key alongside its content key, which resolves the identity of each iterate. (ii) It restricts each layer to a residual window of the previous W W loops, which bounds the number of sources as the loop deepens. Figure 8 provides PyTorch-style pseudo code.
blocks.zh:
基于上述分析,我们提出LoopRes,一种有效、可扩展和简单的方法,将循环转化为预先培训的LLMs的重大和持续收益。
如图1d所示,LoopRes保持了AttnRes的输入依赖机制并引入了两种改进方法:(一)它将每个源与内容密钥一起分配出一个有环感的密钥,这个密钥解决了每个端格的特性. (二)将每层限制在之前W W回路的剩余窗口上,该窗口随着回路的加深而约束出源的数量. 图8提供PyTorch风格的伪码.

The other 3 loop the middle half of the layers as LoopRes does: Huginn ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) , Hyperloop ( Zeitoun et al., 2026 ) , and WMRE ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) .
All baselines are compared at 2 × \times and 4 × \times compute, corresponding to L = 2 , 4 L=2,4 for all-layer baselines and L = 3 , 7 L=3,7 for half-layer ones.

blocks.en: 3.5 Analysis

blocks.en:
We visualize how LoopRes weighs its sources, revealing three patterns. • Iterative loop updates. In Figure 6 a,b, each layer balances its input across the prelude, the loop outputs, and the partial sum.
Within the loop outputs, the first block mainly updates its own output from the previous loop, with a small share from the other block of that loop.
The second block on average relies most on the first block of the current loop, indicating that LoopRes learns the iterative structure of the loop. • Dominant loop-aware keys. In Figure 6 c, the loop-aware key accounts for most of the selection at both compute budgets, with the content key taking a smaller share. • Adaptive content keys. Despite its smaller share, the content key lets each token choose its own depth.
In Figure 6 d, simple tokens such as “But” and “Wait” favor shallower outputs, while difficult tokens such as digits and math symbols favor deeper ones.
This suggests that the content key recognizes the difficulty of each token and allocates computation accordingly.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Residual connections ( He et al., 2016 ) add each layer’s output to a shared stream with fixed unit weights and remain standard in modern LLMs.
DenseNet ( Huang et al., 2017 ) instead feeds each layer the outputs of all preceding layers.
mHC ( Xie et al., 2025 ) expands the residual stream into parallel streams and constrains their mixing to preserve the identity mapping.
AttnRes ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) replaces the fixed accumulation with softmax attention over preceding layer outputs, allowing each layer to aggregate them with learned, input-dependent weights.
However, these designs target non-looped networks, where the sources differ in content and are fixed in number.
LoopRes is instead designed for loops, where the sources are iterates of the same layers and grow with the loop count.
blocks.zh:
剩余连接 (He等,2016年) 将每层的输出加入有固定单位重量的共享流并保持现代LLMs的标准.
DenseNet (Huang等人, 2017) 转而为每一层提供前几层的输出.
mHC (Xie等,2025年)将残留的溪流扩展为平行溪流并限制其混合以保存身份映射.
AttnRes (基米语) Team等,2026)用软马克斯注意力来取代固定的积分,凌驾于前层输出之上,使每层的积分都能够以有学问的,依赖输入的权重来相聚.
然而,这些设计针对的是非有轨电车网络,其来源在内容上不同,数量上固定.
循环Res相反是为循环而设计的,其中源是同层相接并随循环计数而增长.

blocks.en:
Layer loops repeat a layer or a block of consecutive layers before advancing to the next.
Sequence sharing ( Takase & Kiyono, 2023 ) ties adjacent layers, so that each unique layer runs several times in a row.
BRT ( Marques et al., 2026 ) extends this to blocks, partitioning the layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reusing each block before moving to the next.
However, both keep the standard residual stream and learn no connections across loops.
blocks.zh:
层回路在向下层推进之前重复一层或相接层块.
序列共享(Takase & Kiyono, 2023)会将相邻的地层连接起来,这样每个独特的地层会连续运行好几次.
BRT(Marques等,2026年)将它延伸至区块,将地层分割为相接区块并相继再用每个区块后再移动到下个区块.
然而,既保留了标准的残留流,又不学习跨环连接.

blocks.en:
Stack loops repeat all layers or a contiguous subset end to end.
Universal Transformers ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) apply a shared transition recurrently with a dynamic halting mechanism, and looped Transformers have since been shown to emulate programmable computers ( Giannou et al., 2023 ) and to nearly match deeper non-looped models on synthetic reasoning tasks ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
堆叠回路重复所有地层或相接子集端到结束.
通用变形器 (Dehghani等,2019年) 以动态停止机制反复应用共享过渡,自此已显示循环变换器可以仿真可编程计算机(Giannou等,2023年),并几乎能与合成推理任务的更深的非螺旋模型相匹配(Saunshi等,2025年).

blocks.en:
Direct looping feeds each loop the output of the previous loop.
WideNet ( Xue et al., 2022 ) shares attention and mixture-of-experts layers across blocks with individual layer normalization, Ouro ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) loops the full stack with a learned early exit for adaptive computation, and TaH ( Fu et al., 2026 ) feeds back logit-weighted embeddings for the tokens selected by a neural decider, with duo-causal attention over the key-value states of earlier loops.
blocks.zh:
直接循环反馈每个循环上一个循环的输出.
WideNet(Xue等,2022年)在单个层平整的区块之间共享关注和专家混合层,Ouo(Zhu等,2025年)以学习到的早期退出来进行适应性计算,TaH(Fu等,2026年)为神经决定者所选择的道具回馈了登录加权嵌入,对早期循环的关键值状态有双重-caus关注.

blocks.en:
Input injection additionally feeds the input into each loop.
Huginn ( Geiping et al., 2025 ) joins the latent state and the input embedding through a linear adapter, Parcae ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) constrains the spectral norm of the injection parameters for stability, CloseLoop ( Marchenko et al., 2026 ) mixes the token embedding into each later loop with one learned scalar, and TaH2 ( You et al., 2026 ) extends TaH with an injection updater and an iteration decider that focuses extra iterations on the tokens that benefit.
blocks.zh:
输入注入额外输入每个循环。
Huginn(Geiping等人,2025年)通过线性适配器加入潜入状态和输入嵌入,Parcae(Prairie等人,2026年)制约了注射参数的光谱规范以求稳定性,CloseLoop(Marchenko等人,2026年)将嵌入后回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回

blocks.en:
Cross-loop aggregation combines the states of multiple loops.
Hyperloop ( Zeitoun et al., 2026 ) maintains parallel residual streams and mixes them with hyper-connections after each loop, WMRE ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) conditions each loop on its differences from recent states, and InfiLoop ( Li et al., 2026 ) keeps a running summary of earlier outputs with content-based weights and a learned temporal decay.
blocks.zh:
交叉循环聚合结合了多个循环的状态.
Hyperloop(Zeitoun等,2026年)保持平行的残余流并在每个循环后与超连接相混合,WMRE(Zhuang等,2026年)对其与近代状态的相差,每个循环都有条件,而InfiLoop(Li等,2026年)则保留了以内容为主的早期产出的运行摘要并学习到的时间衰减.

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, the input of each loop in these designs remains one or a few states compressed from earlier loops.
Different from them, LoopRes keeps each block output as a separate source and lets every sub-layer build its input by attending directly to the sources of the latest W W loops, with a loop-aware key that tells the iterates apart.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,这些设计中每个循环的输入仍然是从更早的循环压缩出来的一到几个状态.
与它们不同的是,LoopRes保留了每个块输出作为单独的源,让每个子层通过直接访问最新的W W回路的源来建立其输入,并带有一个循环意识的密钥来告诉异位.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we presented LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops.
LoopRes assigns each source a trainable loop-aware key that encodes the structural relationship of loops and layers, and restricts each layer to a residual window of the latest W W loops so that every loop builds incrementally on recent ones.
Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 math and code benchmarks, LoopRes delivered significant and consistent gains, more than doubling the improvement of the strongest baseline at 2 × \times compute.
Its score rose with a steeper slope than SFT as compute grew, reaching a higher ceiling and needing less compute to match SFT on long outputs.
As illustrated in , these advantages benefit both inference and post-training rollouts.
We hope LoopRes serves as a simple and effective foundation for scaling LLMs along the loop-depth axis.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了LoopRes,一种有效,可扩展,简单的方法,让每个被环绕的层直接关注早期循环的输出.
loopRes为每个源指定了可受训练的可感知回路密钥来编码回路和地层的结构关系,并限制每回路被限制在最新的W W回路的剩余窗口上,使每回路被逐渐地建立在最近回路上.
在3个模范家庭和9个数学和密码基准的6个经过预先培训的LLMs中,LoopRes取得了显著和一致的成果,在2xxx时间计算上将最强基线的改进翻了一番以上。
其分数上升,比SFT更陡峭,因为计算增加,达到更高的上限,需要较少的计算才能与SFT在长产出上相匹配.
正如上文所说明的,这些优势既有利于推论,也有利于培训后的推广。
我们希望LoopRes成为沿环深轴线扩大LLMS的简单而有效的基础.

blocks.en:
Our experiments cover math and code benchmarks, and the gains on broader tasks such as general instruction following and open-ended generation remain to be validated.
Additionally, LoopRes has been evaluated with supervised finetuning only, and its interaction with reinforcement learning has not yet been explored.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验涉及数学和密码基准,在诸如一般教学和开放一代等更广泛的任务上取得的成果仍有待验证。
此外,对LoopRes只进行了有监督的微调评估,尚未探讨其与强化学习的互动。

blocks.en:
One key direction is to combine LoopRes with reinforcement learning, where the lower cost of matching SFT on long outputs could reduce the rollout budget.
Another direction is to explore adaptive loop depth, allowing the model to decide how many loops each token or sequence needs.
Furthermore, our findings suggest that the loop-depth scaling curve has not yet saturated on larger backbones, motivating further study of looping at greater scale.
Finally, our analysis reveals that the learned loop dependencies follow clear, structured patterns, suggesting that a simpler, fixed connection scheme may capture most of the benefit without the overhead of learned attention weights.
blocks.zh:
一个关键方向是将LooperRes与强化学习相结合,因为将SFT与长期产出相匹配的较低费用会减少推出预算。
另一个方向是探索适应性循环深度,让模型决定每个符号或序列需要多少循环.
此外,我们的调查结果表明,环深缩放曲线尚未饱和到更大的骨干上,从而促使人们进一步研究更大规模的环绕。
最后,我们的分析表明,学到的循环依赖遵循清晰的,结构化的模式,表明一个更简单,固定的连接计划可以捕捉到大部分的效益,而不需要吸取的注意力权重的管理费.

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en:
LoopRes improves the math and code performance of pretrained LLMs by finetuning them into loops, rather than pretraining larger models from scratch.
This may lower the cost of obtaining capable models and broaden access for researchers and practitioners.
However, stronger reasoning and coding capabilities may also be misused, for example to generate malicious code.
We therefore encourage safety evaluations and safeguards before deployment.
Finally, looping increases the computation per token, which may raise energy consumption at scale.
blocks.zh:
LoopRes通过将预训LLMs微调为回路来改进其数学和代码性能,而不是从零开始预先训练出更大的模型.
这可能会降低获得能建模的成本并拓宽研究人员和从业人员的获取途径.
然而,更强的推理和编码能力也可能被滥用,例如用来生成恶意代码.
因此,我们鼓励在部署之前进行安全评估和保障。
最后,环绕会增加每个符号的计算,这可能会提高规模的能耗.
